testcase.name: opening a session does not close its surface immediately
a stop with an open session reports that the session took the route over
a reroute outside a session does not open one
a stop without a session reports that no session took the route over
a fresh state owner has no session
grace expiry ends the session and clears the route
a stopped session is not persisted across a state-owner recreation
opening a session twice keeps the state
a calculation without geometry publishes the endpoint fallback
stopping navigation moves an open session into its stopped state
grace expiry while nothing is on screen writes only the session end
ending without a session changes nothing
ending the session clears the route and resets the state
restarting navigation inside the grace keeps the route and cancels expiry
ending from the stopped state clears the route immediately
opening a session during navigation keeps the adopted route
opening a session during navigation reviews read-only
an adopted route without geometry keeps the geometry already drawn
grace expiry closes the surface
opening a session on an adopted route reviews it
opening a session without a route starts editing
a calculated route moves the session to reviewing
stopping navigation without a session opens none
start navigation ends the session but keeps the route drawn
